title: Claude Code Mobile Environment — unified readiness master plan
objective: Consolidate three concurrent efforts on the same concern into one master plan: this session's forensic audit of the cloud/mobile surface from the Python governance repo, the sibling plan at WIP/claude-code-mobile-environment written from the TypeScript node fleet, and the unmerged code on branch claude/startup-audit-review-bmj21b. Restore full non-memory readiness for Claude Code Mobile, make the wiring self-healing, land the in-flight code without its three merge regressions, and give the TypeScript consumer repos the same governed session contract. Memory is fenced out of scope throughout.

todos.task: Write ops/scripts/link_local_l9_packages.sh in this repository: for each scoped dependency declared by a caller repo, locate the sibling source checkout and install it from that local source so a model-controlled session gains validation capability without a PAT. Read the mapping from a declared ops/scripts/l9_package_sources.yaml rather than rediscovering it by find each session. Four invariants are binding, two of them established against the vendor's official documentation rather than assumed. First, pass --no-save explicitly: the package manager saves to dependencies by default, so a folder specifier would otherwise write a local-path entry into the caller's manifest and break the byte-identical guarantee below. Second, build the sibling and provision its own runtime dependencies before linking: a folder outside the project root is only symlinked and its dependencies are NOT installed, so an unbuilt sibling yields a link that fails at import time. Third, write only into the ignored dependency directory and leave the caller's manifest and lockfile byte-identical to main. Fourth, print each resolved local version against the declared range and warn on mismatch, so a drifted local source cannot masquerade as CI truth.
todos.shared_root_cause: F: model-controlled node sessions start with zero validation capability

disconfirming_questions: Is replaying the in-flight branch actually cheaper than abandoning it? Its author may be mid-flight on that branch, and a replay by a different agent silently invalidates their working tree — the coordination cost may exceed the value of the three improvements being salvaged.

Does main's refuse-rather-than-guess posture beat the branch's warn-and-continue, or is the reverse true for the node fleet? Refusing is safer for a single repo but leaves a multi-repo session with nothing wired, which is precisely the sibling plan's complaint.

If project skills are not re-scanned mid-session, does the multi-repo contract help at all in a fleet session, or does every node repo still need its own committed settings.json regardless of what the governance reconcile does?

Is the four-skill registry split actually a defect, or a deliberate separation where account-synced skills are meant to be fleet-wide and repo skills project-scoped? Treating it as drift may destroy an intentional boundary.
Does consolidating three efforts into one master plan create a single oversized change that cannot be reviewed or reverted independently, trading three tractable PRs for one unmergeable one?
If the broker is never deployed, does the honest degraded posture quietly become permanent, turning a mandatory rule into one that constrains nothing?
assumed_false_ifs: Assumed: the in-flight branch is abandoned or parkable. False if its author is actively working it, in which case the correct move is to hand them the merge-hazard evidence and let them rebase, not to replay their work.

Assumed: SessionStart can mutate the project .claude tree. False if the harness snapshots project configuration before hooks run, in which case the reconcile must move back to the account Setup script.

Assumed: the node repositories are reliably co-located in one workspace. The sibling plan's own U2 flags this as unverified, and if co-location was specific to one remote session then the link script's sibling-path assumption collapses.

Assumed: the broker hostname in the manifest is the intended production target. False if the deployment moved to an internal-only name, in which case the operator paste and the deployment both target the wrong place.

Assumed: the account skill registry cannot be written from this repository. The sibling plan resolved this by probe, but if a supported sync path exists then the registry-reconciliation todo is far cheaper than planned.

Assumed: full skill reconciliation is the goal. False if the account registry is a deliberately curated subset for model surfaces, in which case reconciling all 51 is an anti-goal and the correct output is a documented boundary rather than a merge.

Assumed: validating against local sources is equivalent to validating against what CI installs. False if a local source is newer than the published artifact, in which case local green is optimistic and the version-drift warning is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
stress_test.blast_radius: This plan now spans four repositories and the shared adapter installer that every Claude surface reaches — CLI, Desktop, Web and Mobile — plus the shared agent bootstrap that Codex, Gemini, Manus and the generic adapter also call. A defect in the workspace resolver or the SessionStart reconcile degrades or blocks session startup on all of them, and the resolver is now the merge point of two independent implementations, which raises the chance of a subtle regression above either one alone. The SessionStart contract is fail-open, so the dominant failure mode is a slower or noisier startup, but a hook exceeding its timeout loses the entire governance context blob including the autonomy profile. The node-fleet items touch three repositories not attached to this session and cannot be validated here. The GH_TOKEN work touches credential-adjacent code where a mistake either breaks gh outright or dilutes the prohibition on real tokens. Memory paths are fenced out and, for the in-flight branch, actively split away.
stress_test.rollback: Each workstream lands as its own branch and PR so W0 through W5 revert independently; the master plan is a coordination artifact, not a single commit. W0 is the riskiest and is reverted by dropping the integration branch entirely, which returns main to its current resolver with no loss, since the branch remains intact upstream. The SessionStart reconcile ships behind an environment kill switch so a bad reconcile is disabled without a code change or redeploy, and the hook's fail-open contract means a disabled reconcile returns the session to today's behaviour. The vendor-only flag adds a new code path and changes no existing default, so reverting it is a deletion. The GH_TOKEN and durable-env changes revert by restoring the prior unset list, returning to the currently observed working state. Node-fleet changes are per-repository commits reverted in their own repositories. Broker deployment rolls back by removing the account variable, returning the capability plane to its present honest degraded posture.

shared_causes: A: adapter wiring is performed only at environment-build time and never reconciled at session time, so one bad build freezes the surface permanently. This is the single cause behind the wrong-workspace wire, the unreachable skills, the stale receipt and the phantom skillOverrides.

B: two skill registries exist — the repository corpus and the Anthropic account registry — with no reconciliation, so neither is complete and the router recommends skills the Skill tool cannot resolve.

C: several contracts and validators are written for the Cursor host and never classify the Claude cloud surface, producing the false-red wiring check, the inert durable env, the GH_TOKEN contract break and the absent slash commands.

D: two independent parallel fixes exist for the workspace defect — main's from PR 231 and the in-flight branch's from an older base — and merging them naively yields duplicate definitions plus an interpreter regression. Consolidating them is a prerequisite for everything downstream.
E: the capability broker is both unconfigured and undeployed, the single cause of every unreachable capability and brokered MCP server.
F: model-controlled sessions in the TypeScript node repos start with zero validation capability because policy denies them a PAT and no local-link path is wired, so each agent improvises.
deletions_or_consolidations: Three plan documents collapse into this one master plan: the audit-derived plan, the sibling node-fleet plan, and the implicit plan embodied in the unmerged branch. The sibling document is retained as the node-fleet detail record rather than duplicated here.
Two resolve_workspace implementations collapse into one, which is the entire point of W0 and a precondition for the rest.
The durable-env todo offers deletion as the preferred option: if BASH_ENV cannot be made to work, remove the mechanism rather than keep a writer whose output never reaches the shells it names.
Findings I1, I2, I6 and I13 from the audit collapse into the single SessionStart reconcile rather than four separate remediations.

final_validation.pass_criteria: PASS on all changed files with no weakened scanner configuration
every Python hook command references the locked governance interpreter and none invokes bare system python3
the workspace-resolution regression tests pass and no existing adapter test regresses
reports no drift and exits 0 against the real project directory
no new failures beyond the pre-existing memory-enforcement schema issue, which is out of scope
exits 0 on a claude-code surface with Cursor IDE checks reported as not-applicable
returns the repository name from a login shell, proving the durable env no longer strips the sentinel
resolves to an executable after the shared bootstrap runs

final_validation.command: bash ops/scripts/link_local_l9_packages.sh --check in a node repo checkout
final_validation.pass_criteria: every scoped dependency resolves from a local source with no PAT and no hand-written stub

convergence.stop_reason: Three concurrent efforts are consolidated into one master plan with six workstreams and one dependency order. Milestones M0 through M3 are executable against verified ground truth in this repository. M4 depends on three repositories not attached to this session and carries explicit blockers. M5 stays blocked on U-01. The most urgent open item is U-02: whether the in-flight branch is still actively worked decides whether W0 is a replay this plan performs or a rebase handed to its author, and getting that wrong either duplicates the work a third time or destroys another agent's tree.

preserved_contracts: Model-controlled surfaces hold capability names only and never raw secrets; raw export stays denied and no credential is added to any environment file or any node repository
surface_trust, resolve_secret and the authed_npm PAT policy are unchanged
The SessionStart hook contract stays fail-open: every failure degrades to a smaller context blob and the script always exits 0
Every Python hook runs on the locked governance interpreter, never bare system python3
make pr remains the only sanctioned route to GitHub; raw push, gh pr create and the MCP push tools stay denied at every phase
L4 local autonomy: no mid-execution push, and remote publication stays gated on the release receipt
install.sh stays idempotent and every step keeps classifying itself BLOCKED, DEGRADED or READY
No scanner, test or gate threshold is weakened to obtain a green result
CI installs published artifacts and remains the sole authority on green; local linking is a validation convenience and never a substitute
During local linking the caller repository's manifest and lockfile stay byte-identical to main
Durable wiring lives in committed project files, never in container-local user scope, which is lost when the container is reclaimed
The memory plane is untouched, and the in-flight branch's memory lifecycle work is split out rather than absorbed

estimate: M0 is one focused session and gates everything else. M1 and M2 one session each. M3 one session. M4 spans three repositories not attached here and is not estimable from this side. M5 is infrastructure and not estimable until U-01 resolves.
